content: Kaka wabim able mir ditali, kara kebi omaskir, ia waiakai wa umerkak wit ikelare. Ese na lelut ia wit waikai, Iesu Keriso e merbim kesge tabagoli able barkak le taba Babim.
Nade able idid tabakiamuda gem baida kiki abi dasmerda. Kiki able le uridli geki urder, kipe wabi peki detagreda able niai idid ge dawer Babidoge okakise a merbim batomerda.
Ki agekar umele uridli ki netatbuai Agudidoge uridli no abra mir tebteb kiki asreda.
Nade wader legize oditautlare, “Kaka Agudira tebud nali,” wi nole abra mir wasorlare, wipe besle uridli, a wi Agudira Mir direda.
Lera lag Agudim kemerkemer obakiamu nade e abra mir odasrer.
Mi umele nale Agudidoge uridli ableglam mi umele dasmerlare nale uridli mokakalam Iesu dawer.
Pedikeredi, kara kebi omaskir, mena uridwa Kerisoidoge ia waiakai mi umele siripkak warder a nole ko abialam nabaspe siripge nade e takomer.
Wa umele uridli Keriso pe barkakle dali; ableluglam wa umele uridli nale pe nade barkak waurder wi Agudira omaskir.
